questions.prompt: Which are Windows 11 minimum requirements? Select all that apply.
choices: A dedicated graphics card with 8 GB memory
questions.explanation: A DirectX 12 compatible graphics adapter is required, but integrated graphics are fine.

questions.prompt: Put these installation steps in order.
items: Boot from the USB using the boot menu
Run Windows Update and check Device Manager
questions.explanation: Back up first, prepare the installer, boot it, install, then update and check drivers.

questions.prompt: What is the minimum USB drive size for the Media Creation Tool?
questions.explanation: The tool needs at least 8 GB and erases the drive.

questions.prompt: PC Health Check says TPM is not found on a 2020 desktop. What should you do first?
choices: Check whether TPM (fTPM/PTT) is disabled in the UEFI settings
questions.explanation: Firmware TPM is often present but switched off.

questions.prompt: A customer asks you to use a free "activator" to activate Windows. What do you do?
choices: Refuse: use a genuine licence, as activators are illegal and often contain malware
questions.explanation: Technicians only install genuine, licensed software.
